verdict.rationale: Raygun docs confirm source map support: automatic fetching if public, or manual upload via JS source map center UI or API, with an external access token specifically for 'Uploading JavaScript files directly to Raygun.' However, there's no explicit mention of a CI-focused CLI tool or bundler plugin (e.g., webpack/vite plugin) for automated source map upload during build pipelines — only generic API/manual upload is documented. missing for 10: dedicated CLI tool documentation, bundler plugin (webpack/vite/rollup) integration, CI pipeline examples for automated source map upload.
